source.title: Crafty the Crafter
source.description:
Alright, the name of my crafter, is Mizzle the Crafty.

It so obvious, even Grok'lo see it! Everyone think his name because he clever. NO! He Ogre, he no clever! It because he good at crafting!

<Grok'lo nods>

Go to Northern Dire Maul and meet with him. Make sure he not distracted with anything else when you meet.

Go alone.
source.objective:
Meet with Mizzle the Crafty in Dire Maul North.

You'll want to catch him with no distractions, so don't kill any of the important Ogres on your way to him, or else he'll have to spend time replacing them and can't help you.

Go alone.
source.progress:
Mister Mok'lo send you? If you big boss, he da second big boss, AND best customer.

Tribute chest always filled with spoils and gold from crafting for Grok'lo. We no ask where he get it all, but it belong to da Gordok now!

Oh, and now that you da new king, and me got nothing to fix up, I can help with smashing together whatever you need me to!
source.completion:
OH NOES! Mizzle put da bat wing and da pretty thread together!

Smashed it a lot, but it need something else me no can do.

Da Ogre Spirit told me it da lightness and da darkness of these two things. They don't get along. Ogre Spirit say it need a dash of Fate that can't be escaped. But me no know what that is.
